A dog-face pillow is visible behind her. (2) Close-up of a light green iPhone where a black clip-on circular lens is being attached and manually rotated. (3) A series of before-and-after split screens showing a retail window, a digital tablet, and a landscape painting where reflections are neutralized. (4) Scene transitions to an outdoor rainy street with puddles; the lens rotation eliminates sky reflections on the wet asphalt. (5) The woman returns to the couch, demonstrating the product size and price. (6) She stands in a retail store, holding her phone with the lens attached, looking into a mirror. (7) Close-up of her wearing large sunglasses; the reflection in the lens reveals her phone screen displaying a muscular man, leading to a comedic reaction.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, medium-paced acoustic pop BGM. A female voice speaks with high energy and clarity in Mandarin, introducing a trending phone accessory. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies the visual transition to a product demonstration. (3) During the split-screen visual comparisons, the narration remains continuous, explaining the 'before' and 'after' results with focused intensity. (4) Short 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects are used to punctuate the removal of reflections in each scene. (5) In the final segment, the vocal tone shifts to a comedic, slightly higher pitch as the 'sunglasses reveal' punchline occurs, supported by a brief musical flourish.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Demonstration -> Practical Usage -> Comedy Twist
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a practical and humorous review of a budget-friendly CPL (Circular Polarizing Lens) filter for smartphones. It aims to demonstrate the accessory's effectiveness in removing reflections from glass, screens, and wet surfaces while maintaining an entertaining, social-media-friendly tone.
